_comment: The one copy of the artifact view-link shape both MCP servers are tested against. Read by tests/Feature/McpContractTest.php (hosted server, App\Services\Artifacts\ArtifactViewLink) and by mcp-server/src/mcp.rs (local stdio server, artifact_view_url) so the two cannot drift apart about the field name or about which link a tier gets. `ephemeral` is the anonymous expiring tier deploy_to_canvas publishes: the Worker serves it to anyone, so it is the raw URL like public.
